messages:
Rhea (CSM): Flagging renewal risk for Orchid — active seat usage dropped from ~62% to ~9% after their ML lead swapped models. Need quick triage.
alerts-bot: alert account=orchid active_seats drop=53pct window=5d severity=high
Marco (AM): Any qualitative notes? accuracy vs perf? procurement chatter?
Rhea (CSM): Procurement noted cost concerns; their engineer mentioned a 'cloud cost baseline' doc and a competitor pilot. Also seeing p95 latency regressions in eu-west.
Sana (Solutions): Can you paste one error or sample request? If it's cache or batching we might have a fast config fix.
Rhea (CSM): Pasted snippet: "WARN: batching overflow -> falling back to single-token loop" from staging.
Elle (Sales): If the pilot is cost-driven we should offer a 4-week Dedicated proof with locked price and tuning session. I'll prep procurement collateral.
Marco (AM): Action: 1) Sana to validate a config tweak (12h) 2) Elle to draft price-lock offer 3) Rhea to message new ML lead (cc @maria_orchid) asking if pilot focuses on latency/cost or accuracy. Follow-up in 48h. I'll track.
Rhea (CSM): Message sent: "Maria — quick check: is the pilot about latency/cost? We can spin a short Dedicated trial + tuning to match cost/latency targets."
Sana (Solutions): I'll run a small repro and test batching/window settings. ETA 10-14h. If fix helps we'll ask them to validate on staging.
alerts-bot: note historical p50 latency=85ms current p50=230ms after drop
Rhea (CSM): Maria replied: "Primarily cost and latency. Open to a trial if we can hit predictable p50 <120ms & cost per 1k toks < $0.40."
Elle (Sales): Great. I'll coordinate pricing ops and get a one-pager to Rhea before EOD.
Marco (AM): Good. Keep updates here; we'll present patch + procurement offer to the customer and tie to renewal playbook.
